page: Microsoft Azure M128bds_v3 is a memory-optimized instance engineered for large-scale enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory density and multi-core throughput. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running up to 4.0 GHz, the instance supplies 128 virtual CPUs derived from 64 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory capacity reaches 1024.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The underlying architecture includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 105 MB L3 cache, backed by instruction sets including AVX-512, AMX (Tile and INT8), and hardware cryptography.

Storage configuration consists of a bundled 429 GB local SSD alongside block storage capabilities supporting Premium Storage. The instance does not include a dedicated GPU accelerator or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on CPU instruction extensions such as AMX and AVX-512 for accelerated mathematical execution.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate exceptional parallel compute and memory throughput. Multi-core stress-ng tests reached 110,265.07, positioning the VM in the top 25%, while PassMark CPU (106,632.43) and PassMark extended instructions (136,404.77) placed in the top 10%. Memory read bandwidth on 256 MB blocks peaked at 433.69 GB/sec, supporting top-tier in-memory performance with Redis SET operations achieving 138.18 million operations per second and database operation scores of 34,375.01. In CPU-based LLM inference, text generation achieved 40.58 tokens per second on 7B parameter models.

With its 1 TB memory capacity and 128 vCPUs, Microsoft Azure M128bds_v3 offers balanced resource allocation for monolithic in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, massive caching tiers, and multi-threaded data processing, though workloads constrained purely by single-core speed or local disk volume may experience diminishing returns relative to overall resource footprint.
description: Microsoft Azure M128bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 128 vCPUs (64 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at up to 4.0 GHz. Equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU) and a 429 GB local SSD, this instance delivers top-tier parallel compute and memory subsystem performance. It incorporates advanced CPU flags including AVX-512 and AMX, allowing it to excel in demanding computational tasks without discrete GPUs. Benchmarks demonstrate elite results across key metrics, achieving 138.18 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 433.69 GB/sec large-block read memory bandwidth, and 106,632.43 in PassMark CPU score. M128bds_v3 is built for enterprise in-memory databases, large Redis or Memcached clusters, data processing pipelines, and CPU-driven machine learning inference.
